Messages.Author: Wouter Kuyper
Messages.Body:
> forgot to tell i got my place in the finals thanks to wouter (we both
> had 1 table win and 3,5 vp) he decided to let me play the finals.

Yeah, well i got my place in a not completely legal manner...

I played a all-aabt-anarch-political-deck, but i forgot to read the
exact text from the feestakes....only for 5caps and up...I was
allready winning the first table when one of the spectators asked why
one of my 4-cap-Aabts was a Baron...
My deck was built with the stunning amount of 3 masterskillcards...

So the judge gave me a warning not to do it again and removed the 2
feestakes that were illegaly played, but i still took the table, which
was too bad as otherwise i really had to battle for it (still would
have had a chance though)

As my decks only way of dealing damage was with votes and i could only
play 1 feestake in the next game, (lack of presence masters) and one
firebrand, the only thing i could do was stay alive with the Anarch
hunting machine...this worked ofcourse, but wasn't very effective in
ousting....(especially with a 12-vote-pact against me on the table) so
the table went through time despite my efforts to make a deal with one
(either) of the pact guys...

I didn't feel my deck was worth playing the finals with, because 1) I
got a TW handed to me, because i played illegally, and 2) my deck
wouldn't stand a chance with only 3 skill cards...

W
